tier_1_territory_who_serves.claim: For any Texas parcel: retail water CCN holder (PUCT), electric retail territory holder (HIFLD), and where available wastewater CCN holder (local layers + PUCT download follow-on).
tier_1_territory_who_serves.also: TCEQ water district / MUD membership as complementary who-governs signal.
tier_1_territory_who_serves.residual_required_on_every_parcel: SERVICE-LETTER-REQUIRED — territory is not tap/capacity/extension commitment.
tier_1_territory_who_serves.why_v1: Statewide, uniform, public-record, already verified on all 28 footprint counties for water CCN + electric territory. Matches the feasibility question 'who do I call' even when lines are withheld.

tier_2_transmission_context.claim: HIFLD transmission line proximity (constraint / interconnection context), never as site electric service.

tier_3_opportunistic_municipal_mains.claim: Where a city publishes mains (Bastrop, Cedar Park, Killeen water, Midlothian sewer, …): show as-built main proximity as city-scoped depth with provenance.
tier_3_opportunistic_municipal_mains.must_state: City-limits / system-extent only; not county fabric; not laterals unless separately LAYER-FOUND.

tier_4_rare_laterals.claim: Cedar Park laterals + Arlington LCRR service-line inventory are real exceptions.
tier_4_rare_laterals.must_not_generalize: Expectation stands: almost none publish laterals.

what_it_must_NEVER_claim: That CCN/territory membership means the parcel is currently served or serviceable without a provider letter
Statewide water/wastewater distribution mains as a uniform public layer
Electric distribution routing (street-level poles/wires) as a public statewide product
Laterals as a default product field outside explicitly LAYER-FOUND cities
Liberty Hill / Williamson-local CCN or laterals extracts as statewide PUCT data
Hydrography, storm drain, watering zones, or cleanup sites as potable/sanitary utility availability
Any privileged / agreement-only utility feed (violates NO PRIVILEGED DATA)
A county_rail cell or atom family — out of scope for this probe
